# Catenary. ## Spatial canvas IDE for AI coding agents. ## Similar Products. ### Engineering & Development. ### LLMs. ### Productivity. ### Marketing & Sales. ### Design & Creative. ### Social & Community. ### Finance. ### AI Agents. ### Trending categories. ### Top reviewed. ### Trending products. ### Top forum threads. @giorgio\_nicolas Infinite canvas for coding sounds wild, nice shoot. Thanks so much, @priya\_kushwaha1 🙌 It definitely felt wild to step away from traditional tabs at first, but once you start laying out your agents and editors side-by-side, it's hard to go back. Hope you get a chance to test it out. Curious, I liked the fact that you can have bundles of terminals. looks funny :) I will try once I have time. Haha thanks, @xesca\_i\_am! 😄 Being able to bundle terminals together into task islands was a huge game changer for keeping my sanity while multitasking. Take your time to try it, and feel free to drop any feedback whenever you do! Giorgio, the idea of having everything spread out in one place where I can actually see what is going on really appeals to me. My setup usually turns into a pile of windows I completely lose the thread of, so this feels like a relief :). That pile of overlapping windows was the exact nightmare that drove me to build Catenary in the first place. Losing the visual thread ruins flow. Having that bird's-eye spatial view brings so much clarity. Would love to hear how it fits into your workflow once you take it for a spin!
